violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website (26 TAC §746.501(a)(23))
violation_type.short_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not have instructions on how parents may access minimum standards online in their operational policy.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not have instructions on how parents may access minimum standards online in their operational policy.
Operational policies is missing information on Instructions on how a parent may access the:  (A) Minimum standards online;  and (C) HHSC website.
At the inspection, the operational policy did not include information related to accessing the HHSC website.
The information on how parents may contact CCR was not included in the operational policies.
The operational policies are lacking of instructions on how a parent may access the: Minimum standards online;  and HHSC website.
The policies were not complete to include the HHS website.
